announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group receives 133 MW order ...
announcements.insight: Nordex Group receives a 133 MW order. This follows earlier orders in October and November.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group signs framework agreements with Vattenfall for onshore wind projects in Germany and the UK
announcements.insight: Nordex Group signs framework agreements with Vattenfall for onshore wind projects in Germany and the UK.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group to acquire C1 Connections, adding specialist onshore tower engineering expertise
announcements.insight: Nordex Group acquires C1 Connections to add specialist onshore tower engineering expertise. This follows recent market entries and strong Q3 results.

announcements.headline: EQS-PVR: Nordex SE: Release according to Article 40, Section 1 of the WpHG [the German Securities Trading Act] with the objective of Europe-wide distribution
EQS-News: Nordex Group to enter Albania with 84 MW order from Verbund
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures an order to enter Albania. This follows recent market entries in New Zealand and Schleswig, demonstrating continued international expansion.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group delivers strong Q3/2026 results: EBITDA more than doubled and full-year EBITDA margin guidance raised
announcements.insight: Nordex SE raised full-year EBITDA margin guidance following strong Q3 results. This follows preliminary reports in October and significant order intake growth.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group to supply DenkerWulf with turbines for a 51 MW wind farm in Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures a new turbine supply contract for a German wind farm. This follows recent order intake growth and market expansion into New Zealand.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group enters New Zealand market with 192 MW order from Mercury
announcements.insight: Nordex Group enters New Zealand market with 192 MW order from Mercury. This follows strong Q3/2026 results and raised EBITDA margin guidance in October.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group reports strong preliminary Q3/2026 results and raises EBITDA margin guidance for full year 2026
announcements.insight: Nordex SE raises full-year EBITDA margin guidance following strong preliminary Q3 results. This follows a significant 29.5% rise in order intake recorded in October.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: Nordex SE: Nordex Group reports strong preliminary Q3/2026 results and raises EBITDA margin guidance for full year 2026
announcements.insight: Nordex SE raises full-year EBITDA margin guidance following strong Q3 results. This follows significant order intake growth in Q3, including 2.8 GW secured.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group order intake rises 29.5% to 2.8 GW in the third quarter of 2026
announcements.insight: Order intake rose 29.5% to 2.8 GW in Q3 2026, following specific wins in Sep and Oct 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group records 389 MW of new orders in Türkiye
announcements.insight: Nordex SE secured new orders in Türkiye, adding to its recent pipeline across Europe. This expands the group's order book following earlier wins in Germany, France, Portugal, Spain, Austria and South, Central and Eastern Europe.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group secures 228 MW across South, Central and Eastern Europe
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures 228 MW across South, Central and Eastern Europe. This follows recent orders in Germany, France, Portugal, Spain and Austria.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Milestone in Austria: Nordex Group receives 56 MW order from WEB Windenergie for first N175/6.X project in the country
announcements.insight: The Group secured a new order in Austria, adding to recent wins in Germany and Southern Europe. This expands its regional footprint following the Delta4000 series launch.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group secures 175 MW of new orders in France, Portugal and Spain
announcements.insight: New orders in France, Portugal and Spain follow the September German contract. This expands the order book alongside the Delta4000 series launch.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group receives 42 MW order from Navaris in Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex Group receives a 42 MW order from Navaris in Germany. This follows a major 525 MW order in Türkiye and an expansion of its Delta4000 series.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group expands its Delta4000 series with new N193/7.X turbine
announcements.insight: The new turbine expands the Delta4000 series. This follows recent U.S. and Türkiye orders, indicating continued product development alongside commercial wins.

announcements.headline: EQS-DD: Nordex SE: Dr. Ilya Hartmann, buy
announcements.insight: Dr. Ilya Hartmann has bought shares, following earlier order wins in August. This indicates personal confidence but limited immediate shareholder impact.

announcements.headline: EQS-DD: Nordex SE: Dr. Ilya Hartmann, Kauf
announcements.insight: Dr. Ilya Hartmann’s purchase follows his earlier buy in August, indicating continued insider confidence in the company.

announcements.headline: EQS-DD: Nordex SE: Dr. Ilya Hartmann, Kauf
announcements.insight: Dr. Ilya Hartmann’s appointment follows recent operational updates and order wins, signaling continued leadership stability during this growth phase.

announcements.headline: EQS-DD: Nordex SE: Dr. Ilya Hartmann, buy
announcements.insight: Dr. Ilya Hartmann has been appointed to the board. This follows recent operational updates including strong Q2/2026 results and significant new orders in the US, Romania, and Türkiye.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group secures a major order in Türkiye totalling 525 MW
announcements.insight: This major order adds to the Q2 2026 intake and recent US wins, reinforcing strong demand. It supports the reported double-digit EBITDA margin achieved in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group secures new U.S. orders totaling more than 480 MW
announcements.insight: New US orders follow Q2 2026 results and a July UKA deal. This sustained order intake supports financial flexibility and margin targets.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group obtains 77 MW order in Romania
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures a 77 MW order in Romania. This adds to the 3.1 GW of Q2/2026 intake announced in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group achieves double-digit EBITDA margin in Q2/2026, strong order intake growth, and positive free cash flow
announcements.insight: Nordex SE reports strong Q2/2026 order intake growth and positive free cash flow. This follows earlier announcements of significant new orders in July 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group strengthens financial flexibility with expanded EUR 2,475 million ESG-linked syndicated Multi-Currency Guarantee Facility
announcements.insight: Nordex SE secures expanded financial flexibility following strong Q2 2026 order intake. This supports ongoing delivery of recent US and UK contracts.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group announces 3.1 GW of order intake in the second quarter 2026
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secured 3.1 GW of order intake in Q2 2026, following earlier wins in Romania, the US, Germany and with ENOVA.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group receives orders totalling 700 MW from UKA in Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex Group receives new orders. This follows recent order wins in June 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group to deliver 20 MW wind farm for Continental tire plant in Korbach, Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex Group delivers a wind farm for Continental Tire in Korbach. This follows recent order wins in June, indicating continued project execution alongside new contract acquisitions.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: The Nordex Group receives new orders totalling more than 197 MW from ENOVA and BMR in Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex SE secures significant new orders in Germany, adding to recent wins in the US and Eastern Europe. This confirms sustained demand for its products across multiple regions.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group scores 325 MW order in the US
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures a new US order. This follows earlier US orders in June 2026, indicating continued activity in that market.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group reaches further milestone in Romania’s Pestera II wind project with start of turbine manufacturing and site preparation
announcements.insight: Nordex Group advances its Romania project through manufacturing start. This follows recent order wins in Germany, Southern Europe, Türkiye, Eastern Europe and the US.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group receives 112 MW order from NeXtWind for wind farm in Saxony-Anhalt in Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures an order from NeXtWind for a wind farm in Saxony-Anhalt. This follows recent orders secured in Germany, Southern Europe, Türkiye, Eastern Europe, and the US.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group secures new US orders totaling 484 MW
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures new US orders totaling 484 MW. This follows recent wins in Germany, Southern Europe, Türkiye, and Eastern Europe.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: The Nordex Group secures 100 MW order in Eastern Europe
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures a 100 MW order in Eastern Europe. This follows recent wins of 255 MW from Germany and 155 MW in Southern Europe and Türkiye.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group records 155 MW of new orders in Southern Europe and Türkiye
announcements.insight: Nordex Group records new orders in Southern Europe and Türkiye. This follows a previous order announcement from Germany in June 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Nordex Group secures orders totalling 255 MW from Germany
announcements.insight: Nordex Group secures orders totalling 255 MW from Germany. This contract win provides new business activity for shareholders.
